name: foreman
description: Runs a parent session's /implement sub sessions: shows them in a band above the prompt and a pane, nudges an idle one, notifies the person when one needs them, frees a slot when one finishes, and wakes the parent's model with one line when there is a decision to make

slots.title: Slots
slots.description: How many sub sessions a parent session runs at once, from 1 to 20, unless /foreman slots sets another count for that session.

idleMinutes.title: Idle minutes
idleMinutes.description: How many minutes a sub session may sit idle before foreman nudges it. The second nudge and then the wake of the parent's model each come this many minutes later.

cleanupMinutes.title: Cleanup minutes
cleanupMinutes.description: How many minutes a sub session may stay in cleanup before foreman wakes the parent's model with its last error line.
